note: THE FLOOR. Every number here was MEASURED, and from now on coverage may not fall below it.
This file exists because 'covered + excluded = total' stays true while the total shrinks and
while work moves from covered to excluded. Both keep the figure at 100% and both mean the site
documents less than it did. Neither is visible to the gate's other checks.
Growth needs nothing: exceed a floor and the gate is happy. LOWERING one is allowed and must be
declared — the gate compares this file against its own committed version in git and fails if a
floor moved down with no new entry in `amendments`. A floor editable in the same commit that
breaches it is not a floor.

tolerance.why: Prose is edited and legitimately gets shorter. A fraction of 1.0 would make every tightening a gate failure and would teach people to raise the floor reflexively, which is worse than a slightly loose bound. This is a judgement, recorded as one.

amendments.why: A forensic pass held all 292 published pages against the commit each citation names and found ONE whose published bytes were an uncommitted working-tree edit published under a commit sha that does not contain them (workbench/living-science-walkthrough). The ingest now fences any document whose own bytes are uncommitted, per path, so it cannot assert a provenance it does not have. The page count falls by one because a page that was making a false claim stopped being published. This is a REDUCTION IN COUNT AND AN INCREASE IN CORRECTNESS, which is why the floor is lowered deliberately rather than the fence being weakened to preserve a number. The remaining four fenced documents return the moment the workbench worktree is committed.

amendments.what: Lowered floor article_chars.run-it (8678 -> 8667), a drop of 11 characters, as part of re-pinning the baseline for the 493-page expansion.
amendments.why: No prose was removed. The run-it page body is byte-identical to its previous version. The 11-character drop is an earlier fix catching up: a dead internal link to a flagellar-motor route that does not exist was corrected to the live route, removing the 11 characters of the word laboratory. The floor was pinned before that fix and is only now re-emitted. This is a reduction in count and an increase in correctness -- a working link is shorter than a broken one -- so the floor article_chars.run-it is lowered deliberately and recorded here rather than the page being padded to preserve a number.

amendments.what: Lowered floors corpora_pages.encyclopedia (45 -> 44), corpora_pages.cookbook (34 -> 32), curation_routes.encyclopedia-method (16 -> 15) and curation_routes.cookbook-kitchen (8 -> 6) — the drop of 1 encyclopedia and 3 cookbook pages, and the two curated routes those pages sat on.
amendments.why: OD-1 containment. Four M25 never-publish files (encyclopedia/master-plan, cookbook/master-plan, cookbook/uni-gpt-consult-2026-06-27, cookbook/uni-gpt-consult-package) were reaching the live wiki past the honesty review, carrying client identity, a zero-auth daemon port and leak-record ids. They are now refused at ingest and re-checked by verify_publish_safe, so they stop being published. This is a REDUCTION IN COUNT AND AN INCREASE IN CORRECTNESS -- pages that leaked never-publish material stopped being published -- so the two corpus floors are lowered deliberately rather than the deny-list being weakened to preserve a number. The sovereign claim-ledger remains published but cut to its publishable sections 0/1/2/8 (the same subset the canonical cookbook ledger omits); that is a redaction, not a page removal, and does not move these floors.
